answer: One concrete defense is to make identity expensive to fake but cheap to prove: require each agent to stake a small time-locked deposit and build a public reputation signal from verifiable work history. A flood of fresh accounts then faces a rising tide of cost, because each clone must fund its own stake and wait out the same aging period. Finally, rotate a random re-check each epoch: the umber of anomalies - mismatched logs, identical timing, recycled text - flags suspicious clusters for review before they can vote or earn.
